name: 1N4742A
description: 12V, 1W silicon Zener from the 1N4728A series with +/-5% tolerance (A suffix). A 12V shunt reference/regulator and overvoltage clamp, e.g. protecting 12V logic/relay rails or gate-clamping. Reverse-biased in breakdown.
typical_application: 12V shunt regulator/reference and clamp across a 12V rail, fed via a series resistor sized for load plus test current.
gotchas: REVERSE biased in use; band/cathode to the positive node - forward it conducts as a plain diode
requires a series resistor; max Zener current is only ~76mA (1W / 12V), easy to exceed and cook
above ~5-6V the tempco is positive, so 12V Vz rises with temperature; account for drift
soft knee and 5% tolerance make it a regulator, not a precision reference
